subject.title: Feature request: MEMORY.md size warning/limit enforcement

question: Should this issue be scoped to Control UI budget visibility first, or should OpenClaw also block oversized MEMORY.md saves and/or auto-archive content?
rationale: Current main already has diagnostics, but save refusal and auto-archive change user memory editing and recovery semantics beyond a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Ship warning-only first
options.body: Add a Control UI MEMORY.md budget indicator and non-blocking near-limit warning using the existing bootstrap budget analysis, while leaving save blocking and archive behavior for separate decisions.

options.title: Block oversized saves
options.body: Make Control UI or `agents.files.set` refuse saves over the configured bootstrap budget, with an explicit override and recovery path.

options.title: Design archive workflow separately
options.body: Treat auto-archive as a memory persistence feature with pointers, undo, and doctor/recovery integration before implementation.

recommendation.title: Ship warning-only first
recommendation.body: Add a Control UI MEMORY.md budget indicator and non-blocking near-limit warning using the existing bootstrap budget analysis, while leaving save blocking and archive behavior for separate decisions.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway agent RPC and bootstrap-context history makes this the best available owner signal for the product/API boundary choice.
